{{Quote|I was wondering, in all of your travels, have you had much experience with Force use among... lesser alien species?|Commander Vilos|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vilos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila]], he asked a fellow Imperial to investigate the rumor of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="TOR" />
